name: ultimate-persian-calendar
description: Jalali calendar, periodic notes and a date-picker API for Obsidian

scripts.format: prettier --write src tests scripts docs/examples main.ts styles.css *.json *.mjs docs/*.{md,yml} README.md CHANGELOG.md THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src tests scripts docs/examples main.ts styles.css *.json *.mjs docs/*.{md,yml} README.md CHANGELOG.md THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run format:check
